swo.label: Skill 1: Subject & Verb
swo.desc: Menerangkan variasi Subject, Verb, beserta kesesuaian keduanya.

swo.label: Skill 2 : Preposition
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Preposisi sebagai modifier, adverb, atau Appositive, serta posisinya dalam kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 3 : Appositive
swo.desc: Menerangkan fungsi Appositive sebagai informasi tambahan dari Noun atau Pronoun beserta posisi dan variasinya.

swo.label: Skill 4 & 5 : Participle
swo.desc: Bentuk Participle, fungsinya, serta perbedaan dengan Gerund

swo.label: Skill 6 : Coordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan bentuk kata yang menghubungkan element yang setara (FANBOYS), parallel structure, dan Subject proximity.

swo.label: Skill 7 : Subordinating Conjunction
swo.desc: Menerangkan kata hubung antar clause (Main Clause & Subclause), tipe-tipe konjungsi, posisi, dan peringkasannya.

swo.label: Skill 8 : Correlative Conjunction
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk konjungsi yang selalu berpasangan, Subject Proximity, dan aturan Inversi.

swo.label: Skill 9 : Noun Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk Clause yang berfungsi seperti noun, variasi, dan reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 10 : Adjective Clause
swo.desc: Menjelaskan Clause yang berfungsi untuk menerangkan Noun atau Pronoun, Variasi, dan pola reduksinya.

swo.label: Skill 11 : AC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-elemen tertentu pada Adjective Clause (AC), konsekuensi penghapusan, dan strukturnya.

swo.label: Skill 12 : AVC Reduction
swo.desc: Penghapusan elemen-element tertentu yang terjadi dalam Adverbial Clause (AVC), konsekuensi, beserta hasil akhirnya.

swo.label: Skill 13 : Inversion in Question
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerja Bantu pada struktur tertentu.

swo.label: Skill 14 : Inversion of Place Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi tertentu yang menunjukkan Tempat dan Arah.

swo.label: Skill 15 : Inversion of Negative Expression
swo.desc: Perubahan posisi Subject dan Kata Kerjanya setelah ekspresi Negative tertentu pada sebuah klausa atau kalimat.

swo.label: Skill 16 : Inversion in Conditional Sentence
swo.desc: Menjelaskan bentuk inversi yang terjadi pada Conditional Sentence (Type 1, 2, 3).

swo.label: Skill 17 : Inversion in Comparison
swo.desc: Inversi yang terjadi pada Subject dan Auxiliary-nya dalam Comparison.

listening-skill1.audioScript: Woman: Have you finished the report for Professor Allen? Man: Almost. I still need to check the figures in the final section. Woman: The professor said he would like to receive it before noon tomorrow. Man: That should be fine. I will review it tonight and send it first thing in the morning. Woman: Great. Let me know if you need me to check anything.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
o: A report that needs to be completed
questions.e: They discuss checking the figures and submitting the report before the deadline.

questions.q: What does the man still need to do?
questions.e: He says he still needs to check the figures in the final section.

questions.q: When does the professor want to receive the report?
questions.e: The woman says the professor wants it before noon tomorrow.

questions.q: The committee _____ the final decision yesterday.
questions.e: The time expression 'yesterday' requires the simple past: made.

questions.q: The new library, _____ last year, is already popular with students.
questions.e: The past participle 'completed' works as a reduced passive adjective clause.

questions.q: Neither the students nor the teacher _____ aware of the schedule change.
questions.e: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Teacher' is singular, so use was.

questions.q: The researcher collected the data carefully, _____ the results were reliable.
questions.e: 'So' introduces the result: careful collection led to reliable results.

questions.q: _____ requires considerable patience and concentration.
questions.e: Gerund phrase Solving complex mathematical problems berfungsi sebagai subject tunggal, sehingga cocok dengan verb requires.

questions.q: Rapid technological changes in modern offices _____ many traditional administrative tasks.
questions.e: Subject jamak "changes" membutuhkan verb plural dasar "change"

questions.q: _____ on the wooden shelf belongs to my grandmother.
questions.e: Kalimat membutuhkan subject tunggal utama sebelum verb tunggal "belongs"

questions.q: A quiet library in the afternoon _____ a perfect place for studying English grammar.
questions.e: Subjek tunggal "A quiet library" memerlukan verb tunggal "provides"

questions.q: _____ are essential for maintaining a healthy environment.
questions.e: Recycling and reusing household materials terdiri atas dua gerund phrase yang dihubungkan dengan and, sehingga membentuk compound subject plural. Verb yang tepat adalah are.

questions.q: Running three kilometers every single morning _____ good for cardiovascular health.
questions.e: Gerund sebagai subjek dianggap tunggal, sehingga verb-nya adalah is

questions.q: Across the wide green valley _____ a small historical village.
questions.e: Inversi tempat: subjek tunggal "a small historical village" berada di belakang, sehingga verb tunggalnya adalah lies

questions.q: _____ and _____ are considered essential for academic success.
questions.e: Dua gerund, reading dan writing, yang dihubungkan dengan and membentuk compound subject plural. Oleh karena itu, digunakan are.

questions.q: Several boxes of chocolate cookies _____ on the kitchen counter.
questions.e: Inti subjek jamak "Several boxes" memerlukan verb jamak sit

questions.q: _____ or _____ is often recommended as an effective way to reduce stress.
questions.e: Dua gerund yang dihubungkan dengan or membentuk compound subject. Namun, karena alternatif tersebut diperlakukan sebagai satu pilihan kegiatan dalam konteks kalimat ini, verb tunggal is digunakan.

questions.q: _____ the new policy will improve educational quality remains uncertain.
questions.e: Whether the new policy will improve educational quality merupakan noun clause yang berfungsi sebagai subject. Noun clause tersebut diikuti verb singular remains.

reading-skill1.passage: Urban trees provide benefits that extend beyond their appearance. Their leaves can provide shade, reducing the amount of heat absorbed by streets and buildings. Trees also help manage rainwater: some water is intercepted by leaves, while roots can improve the soil's ability to absorb rainfall. In addition, urban vegetation creates habitats for birds and insects. However, planting trees in cities requires careful planning. Species must be selected according to local climate, available space, and maintenance needs. A tree that grows well in a park may not be suitable for a narrow sidewalk where roots could damage pavement or underground pipes. Therefore, successful urban forestry depends not simply on planting more trees, but on choosing appropriate species and caring for them over time.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
o: Why cities should remove old trees
The benefits of urban trees and the need for careful planning
Why all tree species grow well on sidewalks
questions.e: The passage describes several benefits and explains why tree selection and maintenance matter.

questions.q: According to the passage, how can trees help manage rainwater?
o: By intercepting water and improving soil absorption
questions.e: The passage states that leaves intercept some water and roots can improve soil absorption.

questions.q: The word 'intercepted' is closest in meaning to _____.
questions.e: In context, leaves catch or hold some of the rainwater.

questions.q: Why might a tree be unsuitable for a narrow sidewalk?
o: It may attract too many birds
Its roots may damage pavement or pipes
questions.e: The passage specifically mentions possible damage from roots.

questions.q: The quality of the products manufactured in this factory _____ significantly improved over the past decade.
questions.e: Explanation: Subject utama adalah the quality, yang berbentuk singular. Of the products manufactured in this factory merupakan prepositional phrase yang memodifikasi noun quality. Noun products tidak menjadi subject sehingga verb harus singular (has).

questions.q: The students in the English department _____ required to submit their assignments before Friday.
The number of participants in the international conference _____ increased considerably this year.
questions.e: Menggunakan "has" karena subjek intinya adalah "The number" (jumlah total) yang bermakna tunggal sebagai satu kesatuan angka statistik. Sementara itu, frasa "of participants in the international conference" hanyalah keterangan penjelas, sehingga bentuk jamak pada kata "participants" tidak memengaruhi kata kerjanya.

questions.q: The amount of information collected during the investigation _____ too large for the researchers to analyze manually.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the amount, yang singular. Prepositional phrase of information collected during the investigation memodifikasi noun amount. Oleh karena itu, verb yang digunakan adalah was.

questions.q: Each of the participants in the international seminar _____ a certificate after completing the program.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah each, yang selalu singular dalam pola each of + plural noun. Frasa of the participants in the international seminar tidak menentukan agreement verb. Oleh karena itu, verb yang tepat adalah receives.

questions.q: The majority of the students in the advanced linguistics class _____ completed their research proposals.
questions.e: Dalam konteks ini, the majority of the students mengacu pada sejumlah mahasiswa (plural), sehingga verb plural have digunakan. Frasa in the advanced linguistics class memodifikasi noun students.

questions.q: The students who participate in the activities of the student organization _____ responsible for organizing the annual event.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the students (plural). Relative clause who participate in the activities of the student organization menjelaskan students. Verb utama are harus sesuai dengan subject plural.

questions.q: Many of the books in the collection of historical documents _____ written by prominent Indonesian scholars.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah many, yang plural. Frasa of the books in the collection of historical documents menjelaskan many. Verb yang tepat adalah were.

questions.q: In addition to the information provided in the textbook, _____ useful for understanding the theoretical framework of the study.
questions.e: Kalimat membutuhkan subject dan verb. Several supplementary articles merupakan subject plural, sedangkan are adalah verb. Frasa In addition to the information provided in the textbook merupakan introductory prepositional phrase dan bukan subject kalimat.

questions.q: The two methods of teaching English to young learners _____ different advantages and disadvantages.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the two methods, yang plural. Frasa of teaching English to young learners memodifikasi noun methods. Verb yang tepat adalah have.

questions.q: Alexander Graham Bell, _____, is widely recognized for his contributions to the development of the telephone.
questions.e: The inventor of the telephone merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan subject Alexander Graham Bell. Appositive berupa noun phrase dan tidak membutuhkan conjunction atau relative pronoun.

questions.q: The principal of the university, _____, announced the new academic policy yesterday.
questions.e: An experienced educator merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the principal of the university. Karena appositive hanya memberikan informasi tambahan, subject utama tetap the principal, sehingga verb utama announced tidak berubah.

questions.q: _____, the capital of Indonesia, is located on the island of Java.
questions.e: The capital of Indonesia merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan noun Jakarta. Appositive diletakkan setelah subject dan diapit koma. Struktur kalimatnya adalah Jakarta, the capital of Indonesia, is located...

questions.q: The novel _____ became one of the most influential literary works of the twentieth century.
o: Animal Farm, a political satire by George Orwell,
Animal Farm a political satire by George Orwell
Animal Farm, was a political satire by George Orwell,
Animal Farm which a political satire by George Orwell
questions.e: A political satire by George Orwell merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Animal Farm. Karena appositive berada di antara subject dan verb, frasa tersebut harus diapit oleh koma. Subject utama tetap The novel Animal Farm, sehingga verb became digunakan.

questions.q: My brother, _____, has recently graduated from medical school.
o: a student of medicine for six years
who a student of medicine for six years
studying medicine for six years was
has been a student of medicine for six years
questions.e: A student of medicine for six years merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan my brother. Appositive berupa noun phrase, bukan finite clause, sehingga tidak memerlukan verb utama tambahan.

questions.q: The Amazon River, _____, flows through several South American countries.
o: the longest river in the world by volume
which the longest river in the world by volume
is the longest river in the world by volume
flowing the longest river in the world by volume
questions.e: The longest river in the world by volume merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan The Amazon River. Appositive ditempatkan setelah subject dan diapit koma.

questions.q: _____, a famous Indonesian independence leader, played an important role in the struggle for independence.
questions.e: A famous Indonesian independence leader merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Soekarno. Subject utama adalah Soekarno, sehingga verb played digunakan untuk melengkapi kalimat.

questions.q: The discovery of penicillin, _____, revolutionized modern medicine.
o: an important breakthrough in medical science
was an important breakthrough in medical science
which an important breakthrough in medical science
being an important breakthrough in medical science
questions.e: An important breakthrough in medical science merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the discovery of penicillin. Subject utama adalah the discovery, singular, sehingga verb revolutionized tetap digunakan.

questions.q: The professor of linguistics, _____, has published several books on language acquisition.
o: who an expert in second-language learning
is an expert in second-language learning
questions.e: An expert in second-language learning merupakan appositive noun phrase yang menjelaskan the professor of linguistics. Subject utama adalah the professor, sehingga verb singular has published tepat.

questions.q: _____, the largest planet in the solar system, has dozens of moons.
questions.e: The largest planet in the solar system merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan Jupiter. Appositive diletakkan setelah subject dan diapit koma. Subject dan verb utama adalah Jupiter has.

questions.q: The committee members, _____, agreed to revise the proposal.
o: who representatives of several academic departments
questions.e: Representatives of several academic departments merupakan appositive yang menjelaskan the committee members. Subject utama adalah committee members, sedangkan appositive tidak memengaruhi verb agreed.

questions.q: The city of Bandung, _____, is known for its educational institutions and creative industries.
o: a major urban center in West Java
which a major urban center in West Java
being a major urban center in West Java is
a major urban center in West Java it
questions.e: A major urban center in West Java merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the city of Bandung. Appositive berada di antara subject dan verb, sehingga diapit koma. Subject utama adalah the city of Bandung.

questions.q: _____, the founder of the Indonesian language movement, contributed significantly to the development of Indonesian nationalism.
questions.e: The founder of the Indonesian language movement merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan Ki Hajar Dewantara. Subject utama adalah nama tokoh tersebut, sehingga verb contributed melengkapi kalimat.

questions.q: The two researchers, _____, published their findings in an international journal.
o: being experts in computational linguistics published
questions.e: Experts in computational linguistics merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the two researchers. Appositive harus sesuai secara makna dengan noun yang dijelaskan. Karena subject researchers plural, bentuk experts tepat.

questions.q: _____, a collection of traditional Indonesian stories, contains numerous moral lessons.
questions.e: A collection of traditional Indonesian stories merupakan appositive phrase yang menjelaskan the book. Subject utama the book singular, sehingga verb contains digunakan.

questions.q: The students _____ in the language laboratory are preparing for their listening examination.
questions.e: Practicing in the language laboratory merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun students. Frasa tersebut merupakan reduced adjective clause dari students who are practicing. Karena blank memerlukan modifier, bukan main verb, practicing adalah jawaban yang tepat.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Reduced Adjective Clause

questions.q: The research findings _____ by the university's faculty members were published in an international journal.
questions.e: Analyzed by the university's faculty members merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun research findings. Struktur ini merupakan reduced passive adjective clause: the research findings which were analyzed by the university's faculty members. Main verb kalimat adalah were published.
questions.topic: Past Participle; Reduced Passive Adjective Clause

questions.q: _____ the effects of climate change, the researchers collected data from several coastal regions.
questions.e: Investigating the effects of climate change merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial, menjelaskan aktivitas yang dilakukan researchers. Subject participial phrase harus sama dengan subject main clause, yaitu the researchers.

questions.q: The lecture _____ by the visiting professor attracted hundreds of students.
questions.e: Delivered by the visiting professor merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun lecture. Karena lecture menerima tindakan (disampaikan), digunakan past participle delivered. Main verb kalimat adalah attracted.

questions.q: _____ the instructions carefully, the students were able to complete the experiment successfully.
questions.e: Following the instructions carefully merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial of manner atau circumstances. Subject-nya adalah the students, yang melakukan tindakan mengikuti instruksi.

questions.q: The book _____ on the table contains several useful examples of grammatical structures.
questions.e: Lying on the table merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun book. Kata lying berasal dari verb lie (berada/terletak), bukan lay (meletakkan sesuatu). Main verb kalimat adalah contains.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Verb Forms

questions.q: _____ by the sudden announcement, the employees immediately began discussing the new policy.
questions.e: Surprised by the sudden announcement merupakan past participial phrase yang menjelaskan kondisi employees. Employees menerima efek kejutan, sehingga past participle surprised digunakan. Subject main clause adalah the employees.

questions.q: The _____ water in the laboratory was immediately discarded because it was contaminated.
questions.e: Contaminated merupakan past participle yang berfungsi sebagai adjective, memodifikasi noun water. Water menerima tindakan kontaminasi, sehingga past participle tepat. Blank berada sebelum noun, sebagai attributive adjective.

questions.q: The woman _____ near the entrance is the director of the research institute.
questions.e: Standing near the entrance merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun the woman. Frasa ini berasal dari the woman who is standing near the entrance. Main verb kalimat adalah is.

questions.q: _____ the historical documents, the researcher discovered several previously unknown facts about the region.
questions.e: Examining the historical documents merupakan present participial phrase yang berfungsi sebagai adverbial. Subject-nya adalah the researcher, yang melakukan tindakan examining. Bentuk examined tidak tepat karena akan memberikan makna pasif.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Adverbial Function; Active Voice

questions.q: The equipment _____ in the laboratory must be handled with extreme care.
questions.e: Used in the laboratory merupakan past participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun equipment. Equipment menerima tindakan penggunaan, sehingga bentuk pasif used tepat. Main verb kalimat adalah must be handled.
questions.topic: Past Participle; Reduced Passive Clause; Noun Modifier

questions.q: _____ by the complexity of the problem, the students requested additional guidance from their instructor.
questions.e: Confused by the complexity of the problem merupakan past participial phrase yang menjelaskan keadaan students. Students mengalami kebingungan, bukan menyebabkan kebingungan. Oleh karena itu, confused digunakan.

questions.q: The man _____ the documents to the administrative office is a new employee.
questions.e: Submitting the documents to the administrative office merupakan present participial phrase yang memodifikasi noun the man. Frasa tersebut menjelaskan man yang sedang melakukan tindakan submitting. Main verb kalimat adalah is.
questions.topic: Present Participle; Noun Modifier; Reduced Adjective Clause

questions.q: The _____ students were asked to leave the examination room immediately.
questions.e: Cheating merupakan present participle yang berfungsi sebagai adjective, memodifikasi noun students. Students melakukan tindakan cheating, sehingga present participle digunakan. Blank berada sebelum noun, bukan sebagai main verb.

questions.q: The professor's _____ of the students' essays took several hours to complete.
questions.e: Blank membutuhkan noun yang berfungsi sebagai subject dari took. Evaluation adalah noun, sedangkan evaluating dapat berfungsi sebagai gerund. Dalam struktur the professor's evaluation of the students' essays, bentuk noun evaluation lebih tepat untuk menyatakan proses atau hasil penilaian. Perhatikan bahwa gerund dan participle sama-sama dapat berbentuk -ing, tetapi fungsinya berbeda.
questions.topic: Gerund vs. Participle; Noun Function; Word Form

questions.q: The professor encouraged students to read academic journals, _____ participate in research conferences, and publish their findings.
questions.e: Conjunction and menghubungkan tiga parallel verb phrases: read academic journals, participate in research conferences, dan publish their findings. Ketiganya menggunakan base form verb karena mengikuti pola infinitive tanpa to setelah encouraged students to.

questions.q: The economic development of a country depends not only on its natural resources _____ on the quality of its human capital.
questions.e: Pola not only ... but also digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua elemen yang setara. On its natural resources sejajar dengan on the quality of its human capital. Kata but also melengkapi pasangan conjunction not only.

questions.q: The new policy aims to improve the quality of education, ______ administrative costs, and increase student participation.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel verb phrases: improve, reduce, dan increase. Ketiganya harus menggunakan base form agar struktur sejajar.

questions.q: The success of the program depends on effective communication, adequate funding, _____ strong institutional support.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel noun phrases: effective communication, adequate funding, dan strong institutional support. Ketiganya berfungsi sebagai objek preposition on.

questions.q: _____ the students and the lecturers were required to attend the academic seminar.
questions.e: Both ... and digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua subject, yaitu the students dan the lecturers. Karena keduanya plural, verb yang digunakan adalah were.

questions.q: Learning a foreign language requires memorizing vocabulary, understanding grammatical structures, and _______ pronunciation regularly.
questions.e: And menghubungkan tiga parallel gerund phrases: memorizing vocabulary, understanding grammatical structures, dan practicing pronunciation regularly. Ketiganya berfungsi sebagai objek dari verb requires.

questions.q: The experiment was repeated several times, _____ the initial results were inconsistent.
questions.e: For merupakan coordinating conjunction yang menunjukkan reason atau explanation. Klausa kedua menjelaskan alasan mengapa experiment diulang. Dalam konteks ini, for memiliki fungsi yang mirip dengan because, tetapi secara grammatical menghubungkan independent clauses.

questions.q: The students were expected to analyze the data objectively, interpret the findings accurately, _____ present their conclusions logically.
The principal, together with the teachers and administrative staff, _____ responsible for maintaining the academic standards of the institution.
questions.e: Subject utama adalah the principal, yang singular. Frasa together with the teachers and administrative staff tidak membentuk compound subject dan tidak mengubah agreement. Verb yang tepat adalah is.
questions.topic: Subject-Verb Agreement; Compound Modifier; Noun Phrase

questions.q: The professor and the research assistant _____ responsible for preparing the presentation and organizing the supporting materials.
questions.e: Subject the professor and the research assistant merupakan compound subject yang dihubungkan dengan and, sehingga plural. Verb yang tepat adalah are. Parallelism juga terlihat pada preparing the presentation dan organizing the supporting materials.

questions.q: _____ the economic crisis affected many businesses, the government continued to support small enterprises.
questions.e: Although menunjukkan pertentangan antara dampak krisis ekonomi dan tindakan pemerintah. Polanya adalah subordinating conjunction + subject + verb.

questions.q: Marsinah continued fighting for workers' rights, _____ threatened by powerful groups.
questions.e: Although threatened merupakan reduced adverbial clause dari although she was threatened. Subject pada kedua clause harus merujuk pada orang yang sama.

questions.q: _____ correctly, the historical documents can provide valuable information about the independence movement.
questions.e: If handled merupakan reduced passive adverbial clause dari if they are handled. Maknanya adalah kondisi.

questions.q: _____ the final report, the researchers checked all the statistical calculations.
questions.e: Before submitting merupakan reduced adverbial clause of time. Subject yang melakukan kegiatan submitting harus sama dengan subject pada main clause, yaitu the researchers.

questions.q: _____ regularly, students may have difficulty understanding spoken English.
questions.e: Unless berarti if ... not. Clause tersebut menunjukkan kondisi negatif: jika siswa tidak berlatih secara teratur, mereka mungkin mengalami kesulitan.

questions.q: The president continued working on economic reforms, _____ by the demands of the political situation.
questions.e: Although pressured merupakan reduced passive clause dari although he was pressured. Kata although menunjukkan pertentangan.

questions.q: _____ a young activist, Munir became increasingly concerned about human rights violations.
questions.e: When a young activist merupakan bentuk penghilangan subject dan to be dari when he was a young activist. Frasa tersebut menunjukkan waktu.

questions.q: _____ the historical documents, the researcher discovered several important details about the event.
questions.e: After examining merupakan reduced adverbial clause of time. Subject yang melakukan pemeriksaan adalah the researcher.

questions.q: _____ by the unexpected announcement, the audience remained silent for several minutes.
questions.e: Surprised merupakan participle phrase tanpa conjunction dan subject. Bentuk lengkapnya dapat berupa Because they were surprised. Subject yang dimaksud adalah the audience.

questions.q: The students completed the assignment _____ additional guidance from their lecturer.
questions.e: Without receiving merupakan prepositional phrase dengan gerund, bukan reduced adverbial clause. Without menunjukkan ketiadaan suatu tindakan.

questions.q: The students were permitted to enter the laboratory _____ all safety requirements.
questions.e: Provided that they met merupakan full adverbial clause of condition. Subject dan verb tetap lengkap; tidak semua adverbial clause harus direduksi.

questions.q: The professor continued explaining the theory, _____ that several students had not understood the previous discussion.
questions.e: Although knowing merupakan reduksi aktif dari although the professor knew. Subject-nya sama, yaitu the professor.

questions.q: _____ under the Suramadu Bridge, I take a bath.
questions.e: Fishing under the Suramadu Bridge merupakan haril dari reduksi. Kalimat lengkapnya adalah After I fish, kemudian konjungsi dan subject di reduksi, verb menjadi Ving.

questions.q: _____ by the unexpected results, the scientists decided to repeat the experiment.
questions.e: Surprised by the unexpected results merupakan participial phrase pasif. Para ilmuwan menerima dampak dari hasil yang mengejutkan.

questions.q: _____ the instructions carefully, the participants were able to complete the experiment successfully.
questions.e: Following the instructions carefully merupakan participial phrase aktif. Subject yang mengikuti instruksi adalah the participants.

questions.q: _____ the teacher nor the students _____ aware of the schedule changes.
questions.e: Pola neither ... nor menghubungkan dua subject. Berdasarkan proximity rule, verb mengikuti subject terdekat, yaitu the students (plural), sehingga menggunakan are.

questions.q: Neither the students nor their lecturer _____ willing to cancel the examination.
questions.e: Pada pola neither ... nor, verb mengikuti subject terdekat, yaitu their lecturer (singular). Karena itu, digunakan is.

questions.q: Both the research findings and the statistical analysis _____ included in the final report.
questions.e: Both ... and menghubungkan dua subject dan membentuk compound subject plural. Oleh karena itu, digunakan are.

questions.q: The university offers _____ financial assistance _____ academic guidance to its international students.
questions.e: Both ... and menghubungkan dua noun phrase yang setara: financial assistance dan academic guidance.

questions.q: Not only _____ the research findings, but she also presented several recommendations.
questions.e: Ketika not only diletakkan di awal clause, terjadi subject-auxiliary inversion. Simple past menggunakan auxiliary did, diikuti subject dan verb dasar.

questions.q: The new policy is intended not only to improve educational quality but also _____ administrative efficiency.
questions.e: Not only ... but also harus menghubungkan bentuk yang paralel. Karena bagian pertama menggunakan to improve, bagian kedua juga menggunakan to improve.

questions.q: Not until the final report was published _____ the public understand the actual impact of the research.
questions.e: Not until yang diletakkan di awal kalimat menyebabkan subject-auxiliary inversion pada main clause. Bentuknya did + subject + base verb.

questions.q: The students must decide whether to conduct the experiment independently or _____ assistance from their lecturer.
questions.e: Bentuk yang paralel adalah to conduct dan to request. Infinitive marker to dapat dihilangkan pada bagian kedua dalam konstruksi tertentu, tetapi harus konsisten dengan struktur yang digunakan. Dalam kalimat ini, to request merupakan pilihan paling jelas.

questions.q: The more frequently students practice listening, _____ they become at understanding native speakers.
questions.e: Pola the more ..., the better ... menunjukkan hubungan proporsional. Kedua bagian harus menggunakan comparative form.

questions.q: The research findings were _____ reliable _____ the previous study's results.
questions.e: Pola perbandingan setara adalah as + adjective + as. Karena itu, bentuk yang benar adalah as reliable as.

questions.q: The university would rather invest in research facilities _____ spend its budget on unnecessary decorations.
questions.e: Pola would rather + base verb + than + base verb digunakan untuk menyatakan preferensi. Invest paralel dengan spend.

questions.q: The professor prefers conducting field research _____ relying entirely on laboratory experiments.
questions.e: Pola prefer + gerund + to + gerund digunakan untuk menyatakan preferensi. Conducting harus paralel dengan relying.

questions.q: No sooner _____ the announcement than the students began discussing the examination results.
questions.e: Pola No sooner ... than memerlukan inversion ketika No sooner berada di awal kalimat. Bentuk past perfect-nya adalah had + subject + V3.

questions.q: In discussing injustice, Prof. Uceng prefers presenting documented evidence _____ making unsupported accusations.
questions.e: Rather than menunjukkan pilihan atau kontras. Bentuk yang dihubungkan harus sejajar: presenting dan making sama-sama gerund.

questions.q: The more people understand the history of injustice, _____ they become in recognizing similar problems in society.
questions.e: Pola the + comparative ..., the + comparative ... menunjukkan hubungan sebanding: semakin ..., semakin ....

questions.q: Historians still debate _____ Tan Malaka developed some of his political ideas.
questions.e: Where Tan Malaka developed ... merupakan noun clause sebagai object dari debate. Where menunjukkan tempat.

questions.q: It is essential that every government _____ the rights of its citizens.
questions.e: Setelah adjective yang menunjukkan keharusan atau urgensi, seperti essential, important, dan necessary, gunakan pola It is + adjective + that + subject + V1.

questions.q: The main question is _____ the government adequately addressed the people's concerns.
questions.e: Whether the government adequately addressed ... berfungsi sebagai subject complement setelah linking verb is.

questions.q: Prof. Yusril Mahendra explained _____ students could evaluate government policies critically.
questions.e: How students could evaluate ... menjelaskan cara atau metode dan berfungsi sebagai object dari explained.

questions.q: _____ the historical documents contain accurate information has not yet been established.
questions.e: Whether the historical documents contain ... merupakan noun clause sebagai subject. Whether menyatakan apakah sesuatu benar atau tidak.

questions.q: The researchers want to know _____ the protesters were demanding from the authorities.
questions.e: What the protesters were demanding merupakan noun clause sebagai object. What menjadi object dari verb were demanding.

questions.q: What the students need _____ a clearer explanation of the historical context.
questions.e: Noun clause What the students need berfungsi sebagai subject dan dianggap singular. Karena itu, verb yang tepat adalah is.

questions.q: Why the government rejected the proposal _____ still unclear to many researchers.
questions.e: Noun clause yang diawali why berfungsi sebagai subject singular sehingga menggunakan remains.

questions.q: The teacher explained that the causes of social inequality _____ complex and interconnected.
questions.e: Verb dalam noun clause tetap mengikuti subject di dalam klausa tersebut. Subject the causes plural, sehingga menggunakan are.

questions.q: Environmental activists strongly recommend that the local government _____ stricter regulations on industrial waste.
questions.e: Kata kerja 'recommend' memicu mandative subjunctive, sehingga kata kerja setelah 'that' wajib menggunakan bare infinitive ('enforce') tanpa akhiran -s.

questions.q: The students were asked _____ the historical speech before the class discussion began.
questions.e: Setelah were asked, digunakan infinitive to + V1. Perhatikan bahwa ini bukan noun clause, melainkan pola passive + infinitive. Soal ini menguji kemampuan membedakan noun clause dan konstruksi infinitive.

questions.q: The professor asked the students where _____ the original documents.
questions.e: Dalam indirect question, susunan kalimat menggunakan subject sebelum verb, bukan inversi seperti pertanyaan langsung. Bentuk yang benar adalah where they had found.

questions.q: The lecturer discussed _____ the government had implemented and _____ those policies affected ordinary citizens.
questions.e: What the government had implemented dan how those policies affected ... merupakan dua noun clause yang sejajar sebagai object dari discussed.

questions.q: The students wanted to know what caused the conflict, why it continued, and _____ it could be resolved.
questions.e: Ketiga unsur merupakan noun clause dengan pola wh-word + subject/verb. What, why, dan how membentuk rangkaian pertanyaan tidak langsung yang paralel.

questions.q: The question of _____ the historical account is reliable remains controversial.
questions.e: Setelah preposition of, noun clause dapat diawali whether. That tidak lazim digunakan untuk memperkenalkan indirect yes/no question dalam konstruksi ini.

questions.q: Historians often study Tan Malaka, _____ political strategies shaped early anti-colonial movements.
questions.e: Whose menunjukkan kepemilikan. Whose ideas berarti gagasan milik Tan Malaka.

questions.q: The professor _____ the students invited to the seminar discussed government accountability.
questions.e: Whom digunakan sebagai object dari verb invited. Subject adjective clause adalah the students.

questions.q: The historical speech _____ during the independence movement is preserved in the national archive.
questions.e: Which was delivered during the independence movement direduksi menjadi delivered during the independence movement. Karena maknanya pasif, gunakan V3.

questions.q: Naar de Republiek Indonesia, the book that explains Tan Malaka's government concept, _____ several important historical events.
questions.e: Subject kalimat utama adalah The book, singular. Adjective clause hanya menjelaskan noun tersebut; verb utama harus describes.

questions.q: Many young activists still read Aksi Massa, a book _____ emphasizes the power of organized people.
questions.e: 'That' digunakan sebagai subjek klausa untuk merujuk pada benda ('a book').

questions.q: Biographers interviewed several freedom fighters _____ Tan Malaka had met during his underground resistance.
questions.e: 'Whom' digunakan karena merujuk pada orang ('freedom fighters') yang berposisi sebagai objek kata kerja 'had met'.

questions.q: Many young activists still read Aksi Massa, a book _____ emphasizes the power of organized people.
questions.e: 'That' digunakan sebagai subjek klausa untuk merujuk pada benda ('a book').

questions.q: Several letters _____ by R.A. Kartini to her Dutch friends were later compiled into a famous book.
questions.e: Reduced adjective clause bentuk pasif ('which were written') menggunakan verb-3 ('written').

questions.q: Jepara is the coastal town _____ R.A. Kartini grew up and began advocating for women's education.
questions.e: 'Where' merujuk pada keterangan tempat terjadinya peristiwa ('the coastal town').

questions.q: During the seminar, we met a researcher _____ has spent ten years translating colonial archives.
questions.e: 'Who' berfungsi sebagai subjek untuk merujuk pada orang ('a researcher').

questions.q: August 17, 1945 marks a historic day _____ Indonesians finally claimed their sovereignty.
questions.e: 'When' digunakan untuk merujuk pada keterangan waktu ('a historic day').

questions.q: Anyone _____ wants to understand Tan Malaka's materialist philosophy should explore Madilog.
questions.e: 'Who' merujuk pada kata ganti orang tak tentu ('Anyone') sebagai subjek klausa.

questions.q: Scholars frequently debate the main reason _____ colonial authorities exiled Tan Malaka multiple times.
questions.e: 'Why' digunakan setelah kata benda 'reason' untuk menjelaskan alasan suatu tindakan.

questions.q: Reading Habis Gelap Terbitlah Terang, _____ contains Kartini's progressive thoughts, inspires many modern readers.
questions.e: Non-defining adjective clause (diapit koma) untuk benda/judul buku wajib menggunakan 'which', bukan 'that'.

questions.q: Biographers interviewed several freedom fighters _____ Tan Malaka had met during his underground resistance.
questions.e: 'Whom' digunakan karena merujuk pada orang ('freedom fighters') yang berposisi sebagai objek kata kerja 'had met'.

questions.q: Satellites _____ Earth at low altitudes capture high-resolution images of shrinking glaciers.
questions.e: Reduced active clause ('which orbit') menggunakan present participle ('orbiting') karena satelit melakukan aksi mengorbit.

questions.q: _____ from recycled ocean plastics, these athletic shoes help reduce marine pollution.
questions.e: Reduced passive clause di awal kalimat ('Which are made...') menggunakan past participle ('Made') untuk makna pasif.

questions.q: Marine biologists _____ deep-sea ecosystems recently discovered a bioluminescent jellyfish species.
questions.e: Klausa aktif ('who explored') dipersingkat menjadi 'exploring' untuk menerangkan subjek jamak 'Marine biologists'.

questions.q: Mount Merapi, _____ on the border between Central Java and Yogyakarta, remains one of Indonesia's most active volcanoes.
questions.e: Non-defining passive clause ('which is located') direduksi menjadi 'located' di antara dua koma.

questions.q: Electric vehicles _____ by solid-state batteries _____ longer driving ranges than traditional models.
questions.e: Klausa pasif direduksi menjadi 'powered', dan main verb 'offer' menyesuaikan subjek jamak 'Electric vehicles'.

questions.q: Neil Armstrong was the first human _____ onto the lunar surface in July 1969.
questions.e: Klausa setelah kata bilangan urut ('the first') direduksi menjadi to-infinitive ('to step').

questions.q: Passengers _____ for delayed international flights received meal vouchers from the airline.
questions.e: Reduced active clause ('who were waiting') menyisakan present participle ('waiting') setelah kata benda jamak 'Passengers'.

questions.q: _____ an experienced neurosurgeon, Dr. Aris frequently leads complex brain tumor operations.
questions.e: Klausa deskriptif di awal kalimat ('Who is an experienced neurosurgeon...') direduksi menggunakan 'Being'.

questions.q: Fresh vegetables _____ at the local farmers' market _____ free from synthetic pesticides.
questions.e: Klausa pasif ('which are sold') menjadi 'sold', diikuti to be jamak 'are' untuk subjek 'Fresh vegetables'.

questions.q: Any applicant _____ with the updated safety protocols may proceed to the practical test.
questions.e: Klausa 'who is familiar' direduksi dengan menghilangkan 'who is', sehingga langsung menyisakan kata sifat 'familiar'.

questions.q: Tourists often feel dizzy while _____ steep mountain trails at high altitudes without proper acclimatization.
questions.e: Klausa waktu aktif setelah 'while' ('while they are climbing') menggunakan verb-ing ('climbing').

questions.q: Ancient manuscripts remain fragile even after _____ inside climate-controlled glass display cases.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa pasif setelah 'after' ('after they are placed') menggunakan past participle ('placed').

questions.q: _____ his medical residency in Surabaya, Dr. Bagas volunteered at several rural health clinics.
questions.e: Menunjukkan aksi pertama sudah selesai tuntas sebelum aksi kedua ('After he had completed...'), menggunakan 'Having completed'.

questions.q: Autonomous drones navigate dense forests smoothly, _____ obstacles with real-time infrared sensors.
questions.e: Participial phrase di akhir kalimat untuk menjelaskan cara/proses dari klausa utama menggunakan bentuk aktif 'avoiding'.

questions.q: Freshly baked sourdough bread develops a crispier crust once _____ on a wire cooling rack.
questions.e: Klausa waktu pasif setelah 'once' ('once it is rested') dipersingkat menjadi verb-3 ('rested').

questions.q: Software developers refused to launch the application, _____ critical security vulnerabilities during beta testing.
questions.e: Klausa alasan negatif yang terjadi lebih dulu ('because they had not resolved...') direduksi menjadi 'having not resolved'.

questions.q: Rare orchids thrive in highland greenhouses though _____ to occasional drops in nighttime temperature.
questions.e: Klausa pertentangan pasif setelah 'though' ('though they are exposed') menyisakan past participle ('exposed').

questions.q: Many remote workers report higher productivity since _____ a structured daily morning routine.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa aktif setelah konjungsi 'since' ('since they adopted') menggunakan present participle ('adopting').

questions.q: Heavy cargo ships must reduce speed upon _____ narrow coastal straits with busy ferry traffic.
questions.e: Preposisi/konjungsi waktu 'upon' (bermakna 'when' atau 'as soon as') selalu diikuti gerund/present participle ('entering').

questions.q: Young athletes avoid muscle cramps during marathons by _____ electrolyte solutions at every hydration station.
questions.e: Konjungsi cara 'by' diikuti bentuk aktif verb-ing ('drinking') sebagai reduksi dari 'by the way they drink'.

questions.q: Marine researchers always double-check oxygen tanks before _____ into deep coral reefs.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa waktu aktif di tengah kalimat setelah 'before' ('before they dive') menggunakan present participle ('diving').

questions.q: Solar panels generate electricity more efficiently when _____ directly toward the afternoon sun.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa pasif ('when they are angled') di bagian akhir kalimat menyisakan past participle ('angled').

questions.q: _____ by local artisans, these woven bamboo baskets sell quickly at international craft fairs.
questions.e: Klausa sebab-akibat pasif di awal kalimat ('Because they are handcrafted...') direduksi menjadi verb-3 ('Handcrafted').

questions.q: Senior editors carefully review every manuscript, _____ factual errors before sending files to print.
questions.e: Klausa hasil/akibat di akhir kalimat ('which eliminates...') direduksi menjadi present participle ('eliminating').

questions.q: Emergency sirens automatically activate if _____ by sudden seismic tremors above five magnitude.
questions.e: Klausa syarat pasif ('if they are triggered') direduksi dengan menghilangkan subjek dan to be, menyisakan 'triggered'.

questions.q: Tourists often feel dizzy while _____ steep mountain trails at high altitudes without proper acclimatization.
questions.e: Klausa waktu aktif setelah 'while' ('while they are climbing') menggunakan verb-ing ('climbing').

questions.q: Ancient manuscripts remain fragile even after _____ inside climate-controlled glass display cases.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa pasif setelah 'after' ('after they are placed') menggunakan past participle ('placed').

questions.q: _____ his medical residency in Surabaya, Dr. Bagas volunteered at several rural health clinics.
questions.e: Menunjukkan aksi pertama sudah selesai tuntas sebelum aksi kedua ('After he had completed...'), menggunakan 'Having completed'.

questions.q: Autonomous drones navigate dense forests smoothly, _____ obstacles with real-time infrared sensors.
questions.e: Participial phrase di akhir kalimat untuk menjelaskan cara/proses dari klausa utama menggunakan bentuk aktif 'avoiding'.

questions.q: Freshly baked sourdough bread develops a crispier crust once _____ on a wire cooling rack.
questions.e: Klausa waktu pasif setelah 'once' ('once it is rested') dipersingkat menjadi verb-3 ('rested').

questions.q: Software developers refused to launch the application, _____ critical security vulnerabilities during beta testing.
questions.e: Klausa alasan negatif yang terjadi lebih dulu ('because they had not resolved...') direduksi menjadi 'having not resolved'.

questions.q: Rare orchids thrive in highland greenhouses though _____ to occasional drops in nighttime temperature.
questions.e: Klausa pertentangan pasif setelah 'though' ('though they are exposed') menyisakan past participle ('exposed').

questions.q: Many remote workers report higher productivity since _____ a structured daily morning routine.
questions.e: Reduksi klausa aktif setelah konjungsi 'since' ('since they adopted') menggunakan present participle ('adopting').

questions.q: Heavy cargo ships must reduce speed upon _____ narrow coastal straits with busy ferry traffic.
questions.e: Preposisi/konjungsi waktu 'upon' (bermakna 'when' atau 'as soon as') selalu diikuti gerund/present participle ('entering').

questions.q: Young athletes avoid muscle cramps during marathons by _____ electrolyte solutions at every hydration station.
questions.e: Konjungsi cara 'by' diikuti bentuk aktif verb-ing ('drinking') sebagai reduksi dari 'by the way they drink'.

questions.q: She _____ to school every day.
questions.e: With a third-person singular subject in the simple present, add -s: goes.

questions.q: There are _____ books on the table.
questions.e: 'Books' is countable, so use 'many'.

questions.q: My brother is taller _____ me.
questions.e: Comparatives use 'than'.

questions.q: The report _____ by the committee before the deadline.
questions.e: The report receives the action, so use the passive: was submitted.

questions.q: Not only _____ the exam, but she also received a scholarship.
questions.e: After 'Not only' at the start of a clause, the auxiliary comes before the subject.

questions.q: The professor, along with his students, _____ attending the conference.
questions.e: The subject is 'professor' (singular); 'along with ...' does not change the verb.

questions.q: Had the committee reviewed the proposal earlier, the errors _____ avoided.
questions.e: A third conditional (inverted) needs 'would have + past participle' in the result clause.

questions.q: The more carefully you read, _____ you will understand.
questions.e: The double comparative structure is 'the more..., the better...'.

questions.q: Rarely _____ such a remarkable performance.
questions.e: A negative adverb at the start of a sentence triggers subject–auxiliary inversion.

sections.content-overview:
Core Structure Axiom

Appositive : Informasi Tambahan

Appositive bersanding dengan noun pada berbagai posisi dan seringkali mengecoh peserta TOEFL dalam menentukan subjek serta verb utama kalimat.

01

Fungsi Noun Identitas

Menerangkan noun utama secara paralel.

02

Pola Punctuation

Diapit dua koma, satu koma, atau tanpa koma.

03

Variasi Bentuk Lengkap

Noun, Nouns, Gerund, To-Inf, Participle.

04

Menghindari Pengecohan

Tidak terkecoh mengira appositive sebagai subjek.

⚠️ Kesalahan Umum (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Subject-Verb Agreement Trap

Terkecoh Noun di dalam appositive

Contoh Sederhana:

❌ Salah: Qofa, a student from Tirto, have glasses.

✓ Benar: Qofa, [a student from Tirto], has glasses.

Contoh Tingkat Lanjut (Advance):

❌ Salah: Dr. Alfajri, along with his colleagues in the linguistics department, were conducting a seminar.

✓ Benar: Dr. Alfajri, [along with his colleagues...], was conducting a seminar.

Subjek utama (Dr. Alfajri) bersifat tunggal, sehingga verb wajib tunggal (was), terlepas dari noun apa pun yang ada di dalam appositive.

Pitfall #2 Missing Main Clause Verb Trap

Mengira appositive sebagai klausa utama.

Contoh Sederhana:

Soal: The meetings, which was held in the main hall, _____ valuable insights.

✓ Jawaban: ...hall, provide valuable insights.

Contoh Tingkat Lanjut (Advance):

Soal: The historical manuscripts, that were recently discovered in the archives and studied by experts, _____ significant linguistic data.

✓ Jawaban: ...experts, reveal significant linguistic data.

Bagian di antara koma adalah appositive (participle phrase). Kalimat tetap memerlukan Finite Verb utama seperti is untuk menyempurnakan struktur.
sections.content-blueprint:
Blueprint & Variasi Bentuk

Apa itu Appositive?

Appositive adalah kata atau frasa benda yang menjelaskan noun lainnya. Berikut adalah 7 variasi bentuk appositive lengkap dengan analisis strukturnya:

7 Variasi Bentuk Appositive & Analisisnya:

1

Noun (Kata Benda Tunggal)

Single Noun
• We students must study hard. (Tanpa koma)
2

Noun Phrase (Frasa Kata Benda)

Noun Phrase
• Qofa, a student from Tirto, has glasses.
3

Gerund Phrase (Frasa V-ing)

Gerund Phrase
• My hobby, writing a journal article, has developed my skill.
4

To-Infinitive Phrase (Frasa To + V1)

To-Infinitive Phrase
• His dream, to get a high TOEFL score, comes true.
5

Proper Noun (Nama Diri)

Proper Noun
• My idol, Nurcholis Madjid, wrote many articles.
6

Participle Phrase (Reduced Relative Clause)

Participle Phrase
• Prof. Muhandis, leading the seminar on linguistics, answered the questions.
7

Leading Appositive (Appositive di Awal Kalimat)

Leading Appositive
• A renowned linguist and researcher, Dr. Alfajri published several books.
sections.content-positions:
Positional Lab

Posisi Appositive dalam Kalimat

Appositive dapat mengikuti noun pada berbagai posisi: Subject, Object, maupun Object of Preposition.

1. Menerangkan Subject Subject Appositive
"Qofa, a student from Tirto, has a pair of glasses."
SubjectQofa
Appositivea student from Tirto
Verbhas
Objecta pair of glasses
2. Menerangkan Object Object Appositive
"I am interested to join BEC, the first English course in Pare."
Subject / VerbI am
ObjectBEC
Appositivethe first English course...
FunctionMenerangkan BEC
3. Menerangkan Obj of Prep Obj of Prep Appositive
"She spoke with Mr. Muhandis, the Head of the Language Development Unit."
Prepositional Phrase:

with Mr. Muhandis (with = prep, Mr. Muhandis = obj of prep).

Appositive:

the Head of the Language Development Unit menerangkan Mr. Muhandis.

Catatan:

Appositive dapat mengikuti noun di posisi objek preposisi.
sections.content-variations:
Punctuation & Layout

Variasi Tanda Baca Appositive

Meskipun umumnya diapit oleh dua koma, appositive juga dapat muncul dengan satu koma atau bahkan tanpa koma sama sekali.

Diapit Dua Koma

Mid-Sentence Appositive

Appositive berada di tengah kalimat di antara noun yang diterangkan dan verb utama.

"Qofa, a student, studies hard."
Satu Koma (Akhir)

End-Sentence Appositive

Appositive diletakkan di akhir kalimat setelah noun utama.

"We visited Pare, the English village."
Tanpa Koma

Restrictive Appositive

Appositive menyatu erat tanpa koma karena memuat identitas spesifik.

"We students must study."

sections.content-overview:
Fundamental Grammar Axiom

Setiap Kalimat Bahasa Inggris Wajib Memiliki Minimal Satu Subject & Satu Finite Verb Utama.

Dalam tes TOEFL Structure, pertanyaan sering disamarkan dengan memperpanjang subjek memakai modifier kompleks atau memanipulasi participle dan clause untuk mengecoh peserta.

01

Identifikasi Subject Utama

Menemukan Head Noun di tengah tumpukan modifier.

02

Subject-Verb Agreement

Menyelaraskan subjek dengan finite verb utama.

03

Phrase vs Clause

Membedakan kelompok kata tanpa predikat vs klausa.

04

Finite vs Infinite Verb

Membedakan verb utama vs verb bayangan/modifier.

⚠️ Kesalahan Terbesar Peserta TOEFL (Common Pitfalls)

Pitfall #1 Salah Menentukan Subject Utama

Mengira Noun panjang / Obj of prep sebagai Subject berbeda.

❌ Salah: The key to the doors are missing.

✓ Benar: The key [to the doors] is missing.

Pitfall #2 Terkecoh Verb Tambahan

Mengira V-ing / V3 berdiri sendiri sebagai Verb utama kalimat.

❌ Salah: The man standing there is my uncle.

✓ Benar: The man [standing there] is my uncle.

Pitfall #3 Kebingungan Gerund & Infinitive

Bingung membedakan Gerund/Infinitive sebagai Subjek vs Verb.

📌 Contoh: Reading books improves knowledge.

Reading merupakan bentuk Ving yang dibendakan.

Pitfall #4 Terkecoh Noun Clause

Mengira Noun Clause memiliki dua Subjek yang terpisah.

📌 Contoh: [What he said] shocked everyone.

Noun clause= clause yang berfungsi seperti kata benda.
sections.content-subjects:
Definisi Utama

Apa itu Subject?

Bagian kalimat yang melakukan tindakan, mengalami keadaan, atau menjadi topik utama dalam sebuah klausa.

6 Elemen yang menjadi Subject dalam kalimat:

1

Noun / Noun Phrase

Standar / Most Common
• Pekalongan is a city.
• Love builds a bridge.
• [The message sent by Almas] was deleted 5 minutes ago.
• [A number of students in the class] join an extra class for TOEFL.
2

Pronoun (Kata Ganti)

She, He, It, They, We, You, I
• She is intelligent.
• They arrived late.
• It seems difficult.
3

Gerund / Gerund Phrase (V-ing sebagai Noun)

Verb-ing as Singular Noun
• Reading improves vocabulary.
• Analyzing adjective clause part is hard.
• Listening, structures, and Reading are TOEFL sections. (Compound = Plural)
4

To-Infinitive / To-Infinitive Phrase

To + V1 as Singular Subject
• To understand syntax is difficult.
• To travel around the world is my biggest dream.
5

Noun Clause (Klausa Kata Benda)

Conj + S + V / Conj + V

Diawali kata hubung: what, that, whether, why, how, who.

• [What he said] shocked everyone.
• [Whether they agree] is uncertain.
6

Ekspresi tertentu

Conj + S + V / Conj + V

Diawali kata-kata tertentu seperti each of, the number of, the majority ..., etc.

• Each of students  does the TOEFL test carefully.
• A number of  are going to analyze the artifact of Majapahit Kingdom.
sections.content-long-subject:
Visual Breakdown

Example of Long Subject Breakdown

Soal TOEFL sering menyamarkan subjek utama dengan modifier panjang. Bedah struktur untuk menemukan Head Noun sejati.

Case #1: Prepositional Modifier The development of modern communication technologies has changed education.
Subject Lengkap The development of modern communication technologies
Head Noun (Inti) development
Post Modifier of modern communication technologies
Verb Utama has changed
Object education
Case #2: Adjective Clause Modifier The students who study linguistics often perform well.
Subject Lengkap The students who study linguistics
Head Noun students
Post Modifier who study linguistics
Verb Phrase often perform
Adverb well
Case #3: Gerund Phrase Subject Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age improves cognitive flexibility.
Subject Lengkap (Gerund Phrase) Learning multiple foreign languages at an early age, Learning sebagai head.
Verb Utama improves
Object cognitive flexibility
Case #4: Noun Clause Subject [What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition] remains controversial.
Subject Lengkap (Noun Clause) What many researchers have discovered about language acquisition
Main Finite Verb remains
Complement controversial
Case #5: To Infinitive Subject To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs are the main goals of the new environmental policy..
Subject Lengkap (To Infinitive) To reduce carbon emissions, to promote renewable energy, and to create green jobs
Main Finite Verb are
Complement the main goals of the new environmental policy
sections.content-verbs:
Arsitektur Verb

Klasifikasi Verb dalam TOEFL Structure

Memahami kedudukan kata kerja dan fungsinya (Finite vs Infinite) adalah kunci utama menjawab soal TOEFL.

1. Berdasarkan Kedudukan (Ordinary vs Auxiliary)

Ordinary Verb

Kata Kerja Utama

Memberikan makna substantif dalam klausa. Pasti ada dalam setiap klausa utuh.

Auxiliary Verb

Kata Kerja Bantu

Membantu ordinary verb membentuk tenses, aspek, modalitas, atau penekanan. 

Variasi Auxiliary Verb:

a. Primary Aux

be, do, have

b. Modal Aux

can, could, shall, should, may, must

Harus V1 bare setelah modal

c. Emphasize Aux

do / does / did (benar-benar)

Contoh penerapan

Miss Farih will have been teaching for 6 months in UIN Gusdur.

Aux: will have been - Ord: teaching

2. Berdasarkan Fungsi (Finite vs Infinite Verb Matrix)

Bentuk Verb Status Finite Syarat & Penjelasan Aturan
V1 (Bare) FINITE Berdiri sendiri (Present) atau setelah Modal.
Vs / es, V2 ALWAYS FINITE Selalu berfungsi sebagai Kata Kerja Utama Kalimat.
V-ing CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be (be + V-ing).
V3 (Past Participle) CONDITIONAL Finite jika berpasangan dengan be atau have.
To + Infinitive ALWAYS INFINITE Tidak pernah bisa menjadi Verb Utama Kalimat.
sections.content-decomposition:
Laboratorium Analisis

Sentence Decomposition

Pelajari bagaimana kata kerja tampak (V-ing / V3) terbentuk akibat proses pemangkasan (reducing) klausa penjelas.

Case 1: Reduced Adjective Clause (V-ing) Active Reduction
"The students studying in the library are preparing for the TOEFL test."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• studying = Infinite Verb

• are preparing = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The students [who are] studying..."

Case 2: Reduced Adverbial Clause (Having + V3) Perfective Participle
"Having completed the research, the professor submitted the article."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• Having completed = Infinite Verb Phrase

• submitted = Finite Verb Utama (V2)

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "[After the professor had] completed..."

Case 3: Reduced Passive Adjective Clause (V3) Passive Reduction
"The book written by the famous linguist has become popular."
🔍 Identifikasi Verb:

• written = Infinite Verb

• has become = Finite Verb Utama

💡 Asal-Usul:

Asalnya: "The book [which was] written..."
